messages:
Elan: Quick sync on the compact 'Version playback' strip in Rollouts. Two pain points: keyboard focus order is odd, and screen readers don't reliably announce the active version. Thoughts? Marta: When you tab into the compact timeline VoiceOver just says 'group' and you lose which version is selected. The visual dot is not announced. Tyler: We've been using a single scrubber control (role=slider) which is ok for dragging but SR users prefer discrete controls. Suggest making each version an individual button with aria-pressed for the active one. Marta: Buttons per version + an aria-live announcer that reads "Selected version v1.4.2, released June 3" on focus change. Also ensure labels include the semantic tag (canary/active). Asha (PM): Agree. Microcopy: the rollback CTA text is terse "Rollback" 12; ambiguous which version. Recommend "Rollback to v1.4.2" and in hover tooltip show the short changelog. Elan: Nice. For compact mode show a one-line truncated changelog and a "View details" link so rollback isn't a blind action. Tyler: Accessibility nuance: if we switch to per-version buttons keyboard users will need a "Skip to latest" control to avoid tabbing through dozens. Add a visually-hidden skip link: Skip to latest version. Marta: +1. Visual contrast: the mini timeline dots are dark grey on white, failing contrast for small targets. accessibility-bot: any suggestions? accessibility-bot: Automated scan: current dot color (#6b6b6b) yields 2.1:1 against #ffffff for 8px dots. Recommend either use brand accent #0057d7 (meets AA) or increase hit size to 10px/12px and add a focus outline. Elan: I'd prefer keeping a compact visual but implementing a 24px tappable hit area with a visually-hidden larger hitbox and a clear focus ring. Tyler: That works. Also for live canaries we only show a small allocation pill "5%". Screen readers don't know it's live. Add an aria-label like "live canary, 5% traffic" and a visible live icon with aria-hidden=false. Marta: Also add an inline pause/resume affordance so operators can stop the canary without opening the details panel. Use confirmation modal with accessible title + descriptive body. Asha (PM): For modal copy proposal: title "Pause canary?" body "Pausing stops new traffic to this version while retaining metrics. To rollback completely, use Rollback." Buttons: "Pause" (destructive) and "Cancel". Decide on button order to match platform standards. Elan: Follow platform pattern: primary action on the right. If "Pause" is destructive style it accordingly but keep consistent order. We'll pull colors from Design Tokens. Marta: Screen reader when compacting hides labels 12; ensure each compact button has an sr-only label with version ID + timestamp (aria-labelledby) so the experience matches the full timeline. Tyler: Key handling: allow arrow keys to scrub and page up/down to jump between major snapshots. Announce the movement in the aria-live region with debouncing (300ms) to avoid spam. Elan: Can someone sketch the proposed HTML roles + a small a11y checklist I can hand to eng? Tyler: Quick markup sketch below: ```html
Skip to latest version
``` Marta: Good. accessibility-bot: validate those patterns? accessibility-bot: Quick scan: markup looks appropriate. Recommendations: debounce aria-live updates (300ms), ensure focusable hit-targets are 24px, test with NVDA+Chrome and VoiceOver, and validate aria-pressed semantics across browsers. Asha (PM): Copy tweak request: change the compact label "Deployed" to "Released" (ops prefers less infra-jargon). No objections? Marta: Fine, but update docs and release notes to match. Elan: Action list: Tyler -> PR with markup + CSS sketch (focus ring, hit target); Marta -> update product docs and copy; Asha -> add VoiceOver/NVDA check to release checklist. We'll review the PR in staging with an a11y pass. Tyler aiming PR by EOD. Tyler: On it. PR by EOD, testing notes included. Elan: Thanks all. Closing thread once PR is open. :thumbsup:
